failure_summary.description: Fresh attraction or hotel searches were made without saving their results.
New flight or hotel preferences were treated as a no-op instead of filtering compatible cached results.
A state abbreviation was passed as an attraction city rather than in the state field.
A broad kid-friendly preference was incorrectly mapped to pet-friendly lodging.
The agent filtered a missing hotel result and repeated unchanged attraction and proximity actions.

patch.reasoning: The dominant failures are already directly covered by the skill: it requires saving new results, executing newly stated criteria against compatible cached results, using the matching location field, and avoiding unsupported preference mappings or unrelated actions. Prior attempts to restate cache and follow-up requirements were rejected, so adding duplicate guidance is not warranted.
